in_sanskrit.name: ककुद्मि

in_marathi.name: Kakudmi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of knowledge and wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kakudmi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kakudmi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Kakud' which means 'knowledge'. This name is associated with Lord Ganesha, who is the god of wisdom and knowledge in Hindu mythology. Kakudmi is believed to bring wisdom, knowledge, and intelligence to the one who bears this name.
